s: February 22, 2018 - In 1980 they released Suicide: Alan Vega and Martin Rev (produced by Ric Ocasek of the Cars), and the same year Vega released his first solo album, Alan Vega. This gave him a Top 10 hit in France with Jukebox Babe.
